  <title>🌿 BRYAN POS — Medical Cannabis POS</title>
  <link rel="icon" type="image/png" href="data:image/png;base64,"/>
  <style>*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}body{background:#080a09;font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"SF Pro Display","SF Pro Text","Segoe UI",Inter,system-ui,sans-serif;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;-moz-osx-font-smoothing:grayscale;text-rendering:optimizeLegibility;letter-spacing:-0.011em;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}#root{min-height:100vh}.num,[data-num]{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;font-feature-settings:"tnum" 1,"cv01" 1}::selection{background:rgba(74,222,128,0.28)}::-webkit-scrollbar{width:6px;height:6px}::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:transparent}::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:#2b312e;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid transparent;background-clip:padding-box}::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover{background:#3a423e}button{font-family:inherit;letter-spacing:inherit}button:active{transform:scale(0.978)}.lift{transition:transform .18s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.3,1),box-shadow .18s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.3,1),border-color .18s}@media(hover:hover){.lift:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)}}#loading{position:fixed;inset:0;background:#080a09;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:#c9a84c;z-index:9999;transition:opacity 0.5s}.spin{font-size:52px;margin-bottom:14px;animation:pulse 1.5s ease-in-out infinite}@keyframes pulse{0%,100%{opacity:1}50%{opacity:0.6}}.bar{width:200px;height:3px;background:#1a2a1a;border-radius:2px;margin-top:16px;overflow:hidden}.bar-fill{height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#b87d5f,#e0b39c);border-radius:2px;animation:load 2s ease-in-out infinite}@keyframes load{0%{width:0%}100%{width:100%}}</style>
</head>
